module.appcast.desc: 把多个后台应用的实时画面放在世界内；独立画质、固定或跟随位置，并可明确开启按住键操作。
Place multiple live application windows in the world, with independent quality, fixed/follow anchors and opt-in held-key interaction.
setting.appcast.width.hint: 调整世界内平面的宽度，不会改变亮度或原始像素。
World-plane width. Does not change brightness or source pixels.
setting.appcast.x.hint: 相对选定瞬间的玩家位置与方向，整体偏移限制在 8 格内。
Relative to the player's position and yaw at placement. Total offset is limited to 8 blocks.
setting.appcast.backend.hint: 自动使用 WGC 捕获硬件加速画面；GDI 只作为手动选择的兼容方式。
Automatic uses WGC for hardware-accelerated content. GDI is available as an explicit compatibility choice.
setting.appcast.nativeResolution.hint: 使用真实客户端像素，不放大伪装高清；支持边长 8192、约 33MP。关闭后可设降采样上限。
Use real client pixels without artificial enlargement, up to 8192 per edge and about 33 MP. Disable to set downsampling limits.
setting.appcast.resolution: 自定义分辨率边长上限
setting.appcast.nativeFrameRate.hint: WGC 帧到即取最新画面，不强制限帧；实际速度受源程序、采集、传输与硬件限制。
Take the newest WGC frame as it arrives without a fixed frame-rate cap. Actual speed depends on source, capture, transfer and hardware.
setting.appcast.sharp.hint: 开启使用最近邻；关闭使用线性过滤，原生像素不会重新压缩。
Enable nearest-neighbor filtering; disable for linear filtering. Native pixel data is not recompressed.
setting.appcast.uploadBudget.hint: 仅限帧模式按预算分条上传；跟随源帧模式每次绘制完整上传最新一帧。
Only capped mode spreads uploads across strips. Source-update mode uploads the complete newest frame in one render.
setting.appcast.interaction.hint: 默认关闭。开启后准心指向画面并按住交互键，鼠标和键盘只发送到所选窗口。
Disabled by default. Aim at a plane and hold the interaction key to send mouse/keyboard input only to its selected window.
setting.appcast.pointerSpeed.hint: 默认 1，按真实窗口鼠标像素移动，不使用游戏镜头灵敏度。
Default 1. Uses physical window mouse-pixel movement, independently of Minecraft camera sensitivity.
mode.appcast_move_first: 默认人物移动，左 Ctrl 切换文字
Movement first; Left Ctrl switches to typing
mode.appcast_type_first: 默认文字输入，左 Ctrl 切换移动
Typing first; Left Ctrl switches to movement
ui.appcast.readOnly: 本地独立窗口投屏；操作默认关闭，需自行开启并按住绑定键。
Local independent window capture. Input is disabled until explicitly enabled and its bound key is held.
ui.appcast.reservedKey: 此键用于面板退出或输入模式，请选择其他键
Reserved for panel exit or input mode. Choose another key.
ui.appcast.inputQueued: 输入已入队，应用是否响应由其决定
Input queued; processing depends on the application
ui.appcast.inputDenied: 窗口拒绝输入或权限等级不匹配
Window rejected input or has a different integrity level
ui.appcast.inputRejected: 输入无效或窗口状态不可操作
Invalid input or window not interactive
ui.appcast.inputReleased: 鼠标与按键已释放请求
ui.appcast.inputBusy: 输入队列繁忙，已请求释放
ui.appcast.gpuLimit: 显卡纹理边长不足，请降低分辨率上限
GPU texture limit exceeded; lower the resolution limit
ui.appcast.wgcUnavailable: WGC 不可用，请选择自动或 PrintWindow
WGC unavailable; choose Automatic or PrintWindow
ui.appcast.sourceStalled: 源窗口持续没有新帧，可重试捕获
Source window has no new frames; retry capture if needed
ui.appcast.nativeHint: 原生模式保留源像素和可取得的帧更新。高分辨率／多画面占用更多内存与显卡带宽；上面的采集与显示 FPS 均来自真实计数。
Native mode preserves source pixels and available updates. Large or multiple screens need more memory and GPU bandwidth. Capture and display FPS above use real counts.
ui.appcast.inputHint: 按住交互键操作，松开或 Esc 退出。移动／文字模式下左 Ctrl 切换；全部按键模式下人物不移动。双击界面键返回普通面板。部分应用可能忽略后台输入；不会主动切换到源应用或发送全局输入。

Hold the interaction key; release it or press Esc to exit. Left Ctrl switches movement/typing modes; all-keys mode keeps the player stationary. Double-press the panel key for the ordinary panel. Some apps ignore background input; the source app is not activated and no global input is sent.
ui.appcast.captureHint: 自动优先 WGC，持续取得硬件加速画面。最小化、受保护／DRM、被浏览器暂停的内容可能不更新；不会擅自更改播放、浏览器设置或切换到前台。

Automatic prefers WGC and continuously receives GPU-rendered frames. Minimized, protected/DRM or browser-suspended content may not update. Playback, browser settings and foreground focus are never changed automatically.
ui.appcast.moveControls: 人物移动模式 · 左 Ctrl 切换文字 · 松开交互键／Esc 退出
Movement mode · Left Ctrl for typing · release interaction key / Esc to exit
ui.appcast.typeControls: 文字输入模式 · 左 Ctrl 切换移动 · 松开交互键／Esc 退出
Typing mode · Left Ctrl for movement · release interaction key / Esc to exit
ui.appcast.place: 重放到身前 3 格、上方 0.3 格
ui.appcast.fixed: 固定：绑定放置时的位置与方向
Fixed: anchored to placement position and yaw
ui.appcast.follow: 跟随人物平移，方向固定
setting.appcast.keyboardOnly.hint: 交互时键盘控制所选应用，人物不移动。关闭后恢复移动／文字模式；退出键保留。
While interacting, the keyboard controls the selected app and player movement stops. Disable to restore movement/typing modes. Exit keys stay reserved.
ui.appcast.keyboardControls: 键盘控制投屏 · 人物不移动 · 松开交互键／Esc 退出
Application keyboard · player stationary · release interaction key / Esc to exit
ui.appcast.keyboardOnlyHint: 适合站立操作：WASD、空格、Shift 和 Ctrl 交给所选应用，人物不移动。Esc、交互键与双击界面键用于退出。
For stationary use: WASD, Space, Shift and Ctrl control the selected app. Esc, the interaction key and a double press of the panel key remain exit controls.
setting.appcast.windowedLiveCompatible.h: 投屏期间将游戏窗口透明度调整为 254/255，减少浏览器被完全遮挡后暂停刷新的情况；关闭投屏或全屏时恢复。不会修改源应用，仍保留原生画质与帧率选项。

While casting, sets the game window opacity to 254/255 so browsers are less likely to suspend fully covered content. Restores it when casting stops or fullscreen starts. Source apps and native quality/frame-rate options stay unchanged.
ui.appcast.scrollUnsupported: 该区域不支持后台滚动
This area does not support background scrolling
ui.appcast.scrollHint: 浏览器普通页面和嵌套滚动区使用后台滚动，无需唤起原程序。自定义画布、网页缩放或音量滚轮不属于页面滚动，部分应用可能不支持。
Browser pages and nested scroll areas scroll in the background without bringing the source forward. Custom canvas, zoom and volume wheel actions are not page scrolling and may be unsupported.
setting.appcast.nativePointer.hint: 默认开启。保留系统鼠标移动与加速设置，不应用游戏镜头灵敏度或额外速度倍率。
Enabled by default. Preserve system pointer movement and acceleration without camera sensitivity or an extra speed multiplier.
